test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The meal was not prepared by us.

options.text: We had not prepare the meal.
We did not prepare the meal.
We did not preparing the meal.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The meal was not prepared by us."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "we" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was not prepared" to "did not prepare" (simple past active).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We did not prepare the meal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"We had not prepare the meal." – Incorrect verb form ("prepare" should be "prepared").
 
• **Option 3: **"We did not preparing the meal." – Incorrect verb form ("preparing" should be "prepare").
 
• **Option 4: **"We did prepare the meal." – Incorrect in negation context, does not match the negative structure of the original sentence.
